args.prompt: A seamless-looking horizontal GROUND STRIP for a 2D side-scrolling pixel art platformer, seen straight from the side (no perspective): a long bank occupying the bottom 45 percent of the image and running off BOTH the left and right edges, its top edge is a bumpy skyline of round puffs of varied sizes, below the top edge the body continues down to the very bottom of the image with soft shading bands. 16-bit Super Nintendo pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline along the top edge, flat shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no text. Everything above the ground strip is solid flat cyan #00FFFF, nothing else. The ground is a bank of fluffy PINK COTTON-CANDY CLOUD in soft pinks (#FFE6F3, #FFC2E0, #F79CCB), like the pink cloud bank at the bottom of the reference drawing.
